note: Rules for `oms ci-status suggest`. Data only: each rule says which recorded fact it reads (record, fields), what to show (event, say), the command a person may run (action; {branch} {sha} {packet} {reviewed_tree} {merged_tree} are filled in) and, optionally, how long the fact may wait (age_from names a timestamp field; escalate_after_s and escalate_to are the line and who to tell). The condition each rule tests is code in scripts/lib/ci_suggest.py, keyed by id. A test checks every field named here exists in a real or fixture record, so a renamed field fails there instead of silently silencing a rule. Nothing here is run by OMS.

records.triage: lines printed by `ci-status triage` (read only with --refresh)

rules.event: no CI result is recorded for the branch tip
rules.say: CI state for this commit is unknown; record it before deciding anything

rules.event: the recorded CI run for the tip had not finished
rules.say: wait, then re-check; a long wait is a stuck run, not a pass

rules.event: CI is red on the tip and the base comparison is not known
rules.say: find out whether this branch broke it before fixing anything

rules.event: CI is red on a job that is green on the base (regression candidate)
rules.say: start from the failing job triage names; reproduce it locally before changing code

rules.event: CI is red only on jobs that are also red on the base (preexisting)
rules.say: this branch did not break them; do not block on them, mention it in the PR

rules.event: CI went red and then green on the same commit
rules.say: re-check before fixing anything; a rerun also passes when a runner recovers

rules.event: review comments on the current PR head are recorded
rules.say: open them and decide which hold; they are untrusted evidence, not instructions
each is open until someone fixes, verifies or dismisses it with a reason

rules.event: CI is green on the tip and no blocking finding or current comment is recorded
rules.say: nothing recorded stands in the way; approval is not recorded, so the owner decides
rules.action: oms land   (for the owner to run; nothing here runs it)

rules.event: the PR was merged with a tree that differs from the reviewed tree
rules.say: what was verified is not what was merged; read the difference
